name: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
summary: Learn a continuous transport vector field by regressing conditional probability-path velocities.
summary_zh: 通过条件概率路径的速度场回归训练连续可逆流，不必在训练时反复仿真轨迹。
core_idea: Regress vector fields along fixed conditional paths rather than backpropagate through expensive CNF integration.
innovation: Enables scalable probability-path modeling including diffusion-like and transport paths.
limitations: Sampling still involves numerical ODE integration.
A learned transport flow does not automatically encode PDE physics.

start_here.why: ICLR method paper introducing conditional vector-field regression.
start_here.focus: Conditional probability paths and simulation-free flow matching loss.

curation_note: Bibliographic identity verified against authoritative proceedings; downstream physical inverse validity must be separately evaluated.
